verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual-mailbox platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API or a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
